THE CODE ANSWERS TO DOOM

Hacknovate 8.0: When Innovation Faces Doomsday ⚡🌌

The world is on the brink. The future is uncertain. And the next generation of innovators holds the power to change everything.

When chaos approaches and the fate of the world hangs in the balance, ordinary solutions are no longer enough.

Inspired by the epic universe of Avengers: Doomsday, Hacknovate 8.0 brings together coders, creators, innovators, and problem-solvers for an extraordinary journey where technology becomes the ultimate superpower.

This is not just another hackathon. It's a mission to challenge boundaries, assemble brilliant minds, and engineer solutions capable of shaping tomorrow.

The threat is real. The clock is ticking. It's time to assemble!

🏆 What Awaits You?

🧠 The Ultimate Innovation Challenge – A high-intensity hackathon where creativity, technical expertise, and problem-solving come together.

⚡ Avengers-Inspired Experience – Step into a universe of challenges inspired by the battle against Doomsday, where every idea has the potential to make a difference.

🏆 Epic Rewards & Recognition – Exciting prizes, exclusive swags, and recognition for the brightest minds.

🤝 Allies & Mentors – Connect with industry experts, mentors, and fellow innovators to transform your ideas into reality.

💻 Build Beyond Limits – Collaborate, experiment, and develop impactful solutions to real-world problems.

📅 Event Details

📍 Location: ABES Institute of Technology, Ghaziabad
🌍 Mode: Hybrid ( Online+Offline)
🗓 Dates: 15th – 16th February 2027
👥 Expected Participation: 8,000–9,000 registrations, with approximately 500 participants at the offline finale.

🛡️ The Mission Begins

Every great battle begins with an idea. Assemble your team, identify the challenge, and prepare to create something extraordinary.

Whether you're a coder, developer, designer, or visionary, your skills could be the difference between chaos and a better tomorrow.

📜 Rules of the Mission

🔹 Follow the official Code of Conduct and maintain professional conduct throughout the event.

🔹 Originality, fair play, and ethical development are mandatory.

🔹 Collaboration and teamwork are encouraged.

🔹 Respect fellow participants, mentors, judges, and organizers.

🔹 Build responsibly and push the boundaries of innovation.



The multiverse is at stake. The challenge is yours.

The world doesn't need another hero. It needs innovators who can build the future.

It's time to assemble. It's time to innovate. It's time for Hacknovate 8.0!

⚡ Welcome to Hacknovate 8.0 – Where Innovation Becomes the Ultimate Superpower.
